---
title: "Real-World Patterns"
---

Each pattern below answers one recurring problem with a self-contained example you can drop into your hooks directory. The example files carry inline `tests = {...}`, so you can run them with `uvx capt-hook --hooks docs/examples test` before adapting them.

If you are new to the framework, work through the [Quickstart](../getting-started/quickstart.qmd) first, then come back here for the production recipes.

## Recipes

| Pattern | Problem it solves |
|---|---|
| [Block dangerous commands](../examples/command-safety.qmd) | Stop `git push --force`, `jj abandon`, and other history-mutating commands with [`block_command`](../reference/primitives.qmd). |
| [Detect weakened tests](../examples/test-integrity.qmd) | Let an LLM read the diff and block an edit that guts an assertion, using [`prompt_check`](../reference/primitives.qmd) with [`Prompt.from_template`](../reference/primitives.qmd) over a [`SourceEdits`](../reference/conditions.qmd) match. |
| [Span a session workflow](../examples/session-workflow.qmd) | Capture intent at prompt submit, record edits as they land, and gate `Stop` if tests never ran, using `@workflow_state` and the [`Waiting`](../reference/conditions.qmd) condition. See [State & Sessions](state.qmd) for the model lifecycle. |
| [Recover from repeated failures](../examples/failure-recovery.qmd) | Fire a [`nudge`](../reference/primitives.qmd) once when [signals](signals.qmd) show the agent retrying the same failure, then stand down once it acts. |
| [Layer code-quality checks](../examples/code-quality.qmd) | Stack a regex `hook`, an AST `lint`, a signal `nudge`, and an [`llm_gate`](llm-hooks.qmd) so cheap checks decide first and the model only runs on the ambiguous case. |
| [Audit an agent run](../examples/audit.qmd) | Write a JSONL log of every tool call and stop event with custom fields and hourly rotation via [`audit`](../reference/primitives.qmd). |
| [Enforce a stop checklist](../examples/multi-step-workflow.qmd) | Require tests, a linter, and a validated artifact before the agent can stop, using [`workflow`, `Step`, and `Artifact`](workflows.qmd). |
| [Flag only touched lines](../examples/styleguide.qmd) | Run `StyleRule` matchers through `styleguide` so a style violation reports only the lines your edit changed. |
| [Write a custom condition](../examples/custom-condition.qmd) | Build a project-specific predicate with the `CustomCondition` protocol. See the [condition reference](../reference/conditions.qmd) for the built-ins. |
| [Configure settings](../examples/settings-config.qmd) | Subclass `HooksSettings` and read your knobs from `evt.ctx.c.*` in a sibling hook. See the [Configuration guide](configuration.qmd). |
